home.heroSubtitle: We design and build props in our own workshop, stock the tools and materials we use every day, and put together producing packs so no shoot ever runs out. If we don't have it, we'll build it for you.
home.missionLead: We exist to make life easier for the people who build the scene: set dressers, art departments, production designers, prop makers and every other film-set professional.
home.m1text: Set dressers, art departments, prop makers... we get you what you need, when you need it, without chasing a dozen suppliers.
home.m2text: The object that doesn't exist, the piece that has to go up in a blackout, the material that must survive a whole tour: we solve it.
home.m3text: Strange, impossible or last-minute ideas. If it can be built, we build it; if it doesn't exist, we invent it.
home.showText: Our own prop designs, workshop tools and materials, tested in real stage conditions.

custom.title: Custom props
custom.intro: Look at the remarkable things we can make for you. From a hand prop to a full scenography element: we combine technical craft with film-grade finishes to solve whatever you need.
custom.cap3dText: FDM and resin printing for precise parts, replicas and prototypes. We model, print and post-process until the piece disappears on camera.
custom.capMouldText: Silicone moulds and resin casts to make multiple identical copies of an object: safe replicas, fragile or valuable pieces and short runs.
custom.capDesignText: We start from a reference, a sketch or an impossible idea and turn it into a real piece. We prototype, test in use and adjust before the final version.
custom.capFinishText: Scenic painting, patinas, aging, lightweight carpentry and assembly. The finish is what makes an object read as real under the lights.
custom.tech2: Foam and EVA shaping and machining
custom.tech6: Basic electronics: lights, sound and mechanisms
custom.tech8: Safe replicas of fragile or valuable objects

about.title: About us
about.story1: Prop a Prop Teu was born in a workshop where we've spent years solving the practical problems of the stage: the object that doesn't exist anywhere, the piece that must be mounted in a 30-second blackout, the material that has to survive a whole tour.
about.story2: Today we combine two things: a shop with products we design and test ourselves (plus the tools and materials we use every day), and a custom fabrication service for any stage need.
about.what1: Our own designs, tested in real stage conditions before we sell them.
about.what2: A curated selection of workshop tools and materials: we only sell what we'd use ourselves.
about.what3: Custom props for theatre, film, TV and events.
about.values: Every product of our own goes through prototype, real-use testing and review before reaching the shop. If a product says it holds 8 kg, it's because we've hung more weight on it, for longer, than the datasheet claims.
about.faqText: Shipping, returns, VAT, custom commissions... it's all in the frequently asked questions.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1_1: Who is Prop a Prop Teu?
faq.a1_1: A small workshop in Barcelona that designs and makes props, tools and materials for film, TV, theatre and events. We are Yerai Bertolín Arch (Senior Set Dresser) and Albert Herrero Parareda, PhD (Lead Designer).
faq.q1_2: Who do you make things for?
faq.a1_2: For the people who build the scene: set dressers, art departments, production designers, prop makers and anyone working on a set or a stage. Individuals are welcome too.
faq.a1_3: We design them ourselves and 3D print them in our workshop, mostly in PLA, PETG or ABS. Before a product goes on sale we use it on real productions; the datasheet on each product page tells you what it is made for (for example, the maximum load).
faq.a1_4: By email at info@propapropteu.com, by phone or WhatsApp at +34 638 00 33 67, or with the form on the Contact page. We answer in Catalan, Spanish or English.
faq.q2_1: How do I place an order?
faq.a2_1: Add the products to the cart and send the order with your details. You get an email with the order summary and the bank details for the transfer. Once the transfer arrives, we email you to confirm the purchase, with the invoice attached.
faq.a2_2: By bank transfer for now. Card payment is coming soon.
faq.a2_3: Yes, all prices include Spanish VAT (21%); the product page and the cart show the breakdown. Shipping within mainland Spain is free.
faq.a2_4: Yes, every paid order gets an invoice, sent automatically with the confirmation email. If you need it in a company's name, tick "I need an invoice for a company" at checkout and add the company name, tax ID and billing address.
faq.a2_5: Each product is printed in the material and colour we have set for it. If you need another colour, write it in the order note and we will tell you whether we can do it before you pay.
faq.q2_6: Do you sell larger quantities for productions?
faq.a2_6: Yes. For quantities beyond a normal order, use "Request a prop" or write to us and we will send you a price and a timeline.
faq.a3_1: We print it when you order it: each piece's printing time plus 24 h of margin. The product page and the cart show you the exact day before you buy. The maximum is 30 days from payment.
faq.q3_2: Do you ship? Can I pick it up?
faq.a3_2: Yes, shipping within mainland Spain is free and takes 1–2 working days once the order is ready. You can also pick it up for free in Barcelona. For the Balearic and Canary Islands, Ceuta, Melilla and abroad, write to us first.
faq.a4_1: Yes: if you are a consumer you have 14 calendar days from delivery to return a shop product without giving a reason. Pieces made to your specifications cannot be returned. Return shipping is paid by the customer. Details in the legal page.
faq.q4_2: What if something arrives broken or fails?
faq.a4_2: All products have the 3-year legal guarantee. Email us your order number and a photo and we will repair or replace it at no cost.
faq.q5_1: Can you make something that does not exist?
faq.a5_1: That is what we like most. Use "Request a prop": describe what you need, when you need it by, and attach photos, drawings, videos, PDFs or 3D files (up to 5 files of 10 MB; for bigger files paste a link). We reply by email with a price and a timeline, with no obligation.
faq.q5_2: Who owns the design of a custom piece?
faq.a5_2: You own the piece you buy and can use it freely in your production, including filming and photographing it. The design (3D model, drawings and files) stays ours, unless we agree otherwise in writing.
faq.q5_3: Can I copy or resell your designs?
faq.a5_3: No. Our product designs, 3D models, photos and texts are protected by intellectual property. Copying, scanning, reprinting or selling them, or making derived versions, needs our written permission.
